review_candidates.description: Company Description POPCORN Studio is an AI-powered creative platform helping brands and creators produce advertising, video, images and audio. Headquartered in Dubai with an office in Cairo, we are building tools for the Middle East and international markets. Role Description We are seeking a Talent Acquisition & HR Specialist for a full-time, on-site position in Cairo, Egypt . You will take ownership of recruitment for our growing team in Egypt, with a particular focus on software engineering, product, design and creative roles. This is a hands-on position requiring proactive headhunting, direct candidate outreach and close collaboration with leadership. You will manage recruitment from defining hiring requirements and sourcing candidates through screening, interview coordination, offer discussions and onboarding. You will also maintain recruitment records, report hiring progress and support day-to-day HR administration. Responsibilities Partner with leadership and hiring managers to define requirements and write clear job descriptions. Proactively identify and approach candidates through LinkedIn, Boolean search, professional communities, referrals and other sourcing channels. Recruit software engineers, product managers, designers, creative professionals and business specialists. Conduct initial interviews to assess relevant experience, motivation, communication, compensation expectations and availability. Coordinate interviews, collect feedback and maintain timely candidate communication. Manage offer discussions within approved budgets and coordinate onboarding. Maintain an accurate recruitment pipeline and report sourcing results, hiring progress and blockers. Support employer branding, employee documentation and HR administration. Handle candidate and employee information confidentially. Qualifications Demonstrated experience managing recruitment from sourcing through offer acceptance. Hands-on experience recruiting software engineers, product professionals or other technical roles. Proven ability to headhunt candidates who are not actively applying. Familiarity with LinkedIn sourcing, Boolean search and recruitment tracking tools. Ability to distinguish between frontend, backend, full-stack, QA and product responsibilities. Strong interviewing, stakeholder management, organization and follow-up skills. Professional written and spoken Arabic and English . Understanding of HR administration, onboarding and employment practices in Egypt. Availability to work full-time from our Cairo office. A relevant degree or equivalent practical experience. Experience in startups, technology, AI, media or creative businesses is an advantage.

Build and maintain a talent pool for current and future hiring needs. Strong knowledge of sourcing techniques, CV screening, interviewing, and candidate assessment. Experience in developing recruitment plans and tracking hiring KPIs. Strong leadership, communication, and decision-making skills. matched_queries.query: Middle East and Africa IT support

review_candidates.description: Company Description AGautomation is a technology-focused company based in Ljubljana, specializing in automation solutions and IT services for a wide range of business clients. The company is committed to delivering reliable, efficient, and innovative systems that help organizations improve their operations. Team members work in a collaborative environment that values problem-solving, continuous learning, and high-quality customer service. AGautomation offers opportunities to work with modern technologies, support diverse projects, and contribute to the stability and growth of client infrastructures. Role Description The IT Technician role at AGautomation is a full-time hybrid position based in Ljubljana, with the option to perform some tasks from home. In this role, the IT Technician provides technical support to internal users and clients, including diagnosing and resolving hardware, software, and network issues. Daily responsibilities include responding to support requests, performing troubleshooting, installing and configuring IT equipment, and ensuring systems are running securely and efficiently. The IT Technician documents issues and solutions, assists with system maintenance and updates, and collaborates with other team members on IT and automation projects. The role also involves helping users with basic training on new tools and systems and maintaining a professional, customer-focused approach. Qualifications Strong skills in Troubleshooting and Technical Support to diagnose and resolve hardware, software, and network issues. Solid foundation in Information Technology, including operating systems, basic networking, and common business applications. Customer Service experience, with the ability to communicate clearly, manage expectations, and provide user-focused solutions. Ability to deliver Training and guidance to users on IT tools, systems, and best practices. Relevant education in IT, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Familiarity with ticketing systems and IT documentation practices. Basic understanding of cybersecurity principles and safe IT practices. Ability to work both on-site in Ljubljana and remotely, managing tasks independently and within a team. Good written and spoken communication skills in English; knowledge of local language is an advantage.

review_candidates.title: IT Customer Service Analyst
review_candidates.description: We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time. Position Summary CVS Health is seeking a Desktop Support Analyst to join a leading healthcare organization supporting a high-volume mail order pharmacy operation. This is not an entry-level role — we're looking for an experienced analyst who can operate independently, troubleshoot complex hardware/system issues with minimal oversight, and serve as a technical resource for junior team members. This individual will provide onsite and remote technical support across a large pharmacy operation, supporting both front-office pharmacy staff (agents, pharmacists, technicians) and backend warehouse/dispensing teams where system uptime directly impacts patient-facing operations. The role also extends remote support to corporate employees across multiple states and serves as an escalation point within a regional support queue. What You'll Do Serve as an escalation point for Tier 1/Tier 2 issues across a regional support queue, resolving complex hardware, OS, and peripheral issues Support front-office pharmacy staff (~15 associates) and backend warehouse/dispensing operations where downtime has direct operational and patient-care impact Diagnose and resolve issues across PCs, monitors, barcode scanners, laser and label printers, and other pharmacy-specific peripherals Own IT asset lifecycle management: inventory tracking, equipment disposal coordination, and asset system accuracy Independently manage project tasks and assigned change control work with minimal manager follow-up Partner with Associate Managers and technical leadership to drive root cause analysis, not just symptom resolution Build and maintain checklists, runbooks, and standard procedures for problem control and prevention Perform proactive monitoring and preventative maintenance to reduce incident volume before it occurs Manage physical equipment logistics (installs, moves, floor and overhead equipment) Respond to and resolve tickets via phone, chat, and ticketing systems within SLA, maintaining clear documentation Provide on-call support on a rotating basis, including weekends, as assigned Schedule Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM HST, onsite in Honolulu, HI. Shift flexibility and periodic on-call/weekend availability required. Required Qualifications 3+ years of progressive Desktop Support / IT Support experience, including direct experience resolving escalated (Tier 2+) issues Demonstrated ability to work independently on projects and change control tasks with minimal supervision Strong hands-on troubleshooting across PCs, monitors, peripherals, and printers in a high-volume, SLA-driven environment Experience managing IT asset lifecycle: deployment, inventory tracking, and disposal coordination Proven track record supporting end users via phone, chat, and ticketing systems, with strong documentation habits Experience acting as an informal mentor or point of escalation Familiarity with remote support tools Ability to work onsite full-time in Honolulu, HI Excellent customer service, communication, and stakeholder management skills Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting barcode scanners, label printers, and pharmacy-specific hardware Experience in pharmacy, healthcare, warehouse, or distribution environments Anticipated Weekly Hours 40 Time Type Full time Pay Range The Typical Pay Range For This Role Is $21.10 - $49.08 This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors. This position is eligible for a CVS Health bonus, commission or short-term incentive program in addition to the base pay range listed above. Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong. Great Benefits For Great People We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families. This full‑time position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues and their families. The benefits for this position include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, retirement savings options, wellness programs, and other resources, based on eligibility. Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments. We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on: 10/23/2026 Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state and local laws.
